# Security and Isolation {#sec-security-isolation}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_How should an agent be contained when its inputs, reasoning, tools, or dependencies may be compromised?_

## Planned Coverage

- Threat modeling across models, context, memory, tools, and users
- Least privilege and capability security
- Process, container, virtual-machine, network, and data isolation
- Secrets, identity, provenance, and supply-chain trust
- Exfiltration, persistence, lateral movement, and incident containment

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to choose isolation boundaries that limit the consequences of both accidental and adversarial behavior.
